findings.summary: the merge gate refused every branch that names no issue, including the docs and planning pull requests the loop merges
nothing wrote review.json's findings, so the gate's blocking branch was unreachable from the command line
the command table and the memory still promised a linked node_modules the code had stopped doing
the pull request description still described the linked node_modules and three tests where the spec said five
a measured directory matched by exact string, so a recorded directory exempted nothing
the fields the gate reads off a finding were not required, so a summary-less finding crashed the merge and two agent-less findings in one round collided
the branch naming an issue no spec claims had no test and no line in the contract
a deep pass recorded with no measured paths exempted every later head, so one command and no review passed the gate
the gate read the local checkout's branch and head rather than the pull request's, so merging from anywhere passed a review the pushed head never had
drop deleted a worktree it did not own: two clones of one branch shared a room and preparing from one destroyed the other's tree mid-review
--findings on a scalar, an object or broken JSON raised rather than returning an error
the return codes of git worktree add and the online pnpm install fallback are discarded, and that fallback has no test
--prepare reports a round it does not persist, so --state disagrees until --round-done
--gates-only does not include the review gate, and the contract does not say so
the function that makes the gate read the pull request had no test, and its failure mode was a green gate
the guard refused any branch whose name is hexadecimal, and an empty branch name passed
a null headRefName becomes the string None, which is truthy and names no issue, so it would merge unreviewed
findings.note: issue #66; headRefName is non-nullable in the GraphQL schema

findings.summary: an oid in both fields passes as a branch that names no issue, which is the designed escape hatch
findings.note: the spec states a branch naming no issue goes through
